description: Component Test (2026-11-12, JD t5295u): no procedural generation. The Flat Lab generator with Wafer Silicon in place of Ceramic: a dead-flat Wafer Silicon plain at y 64 (both graph outputs are scale-0 constants), no carvers, no features, no foliage, every chunk the same out to the far edge. Materials are the exact block id lithokraft:silicon (Wafer Silicon), not a texture key. Used only by --component-test, which builds one 3x3-chunk pad per Trace component on it.
